source.title: 诸福棠实用儿科学（第9版）
source.evidence: User-supplied photographs; qualitative morphology, not digitized patient samples.

scope: Mirror-image dextrocardia with standard limb and left precordial positions. Not non-mirror dextrocardia, dextroposition or arm wiring reversal. No right-precordial channels in this template.
constraints: I inverted; II/III and aVR/aVL exchanged; aVF unchanged relative to the reference.
Left precordial R amplitude regresses, V2-V6 are S-dominant and distant left chest voltage diminishes.
Book V3R/V5R/V6R are right chest positions, not ordinary V3/V5/V6. The printed 1/2 is a gain annotation, not a physiological amplitude multiplier.
authored_note: All amplitudes and timing are teaching choices, not measurements from the photograph or pediatric reference limits. Reference sinus timing and perfusion are retained.
